record.bible_text: A Song<WH07892> of degrees<WH04609>. LORD<WH03068>, remember<WH02142><WTH8798> David<WH01732>, <FI>and<Fi> all his afflictions<WH06031><WTH8793>:

I will not give<WH05414><WTH8799> sleep<WH08153> to mine eyes<WH05869>, <FI>or<Fi> slumber<WH08572> to mine eyelids<WH06079>,
Until I find out<WH04672><WTH8799> a place<WH04725> for the LORD<WH03068>, an habitation<WH04908> for the mighty<WH046> <FI>God<Fi> of Jacob<WH03290>. <RF>an habitation: Heb. habitations<Rf>
Lo, we heard<WH08085><WTH8804> of it at Ephratah<WH0672>: we found<WH04672><WTH8804> it in the fields<WH07704> of the wood<WH03293>.
We will go<WH0935><WTH8799> into his tabernacles<WH04908>: we will worship<WH07812><WTH8691> at his footstool<WH01916><WH07272>.
Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, into thy rest<WH04496>; thou, and the ark<WH0727> of thy strength<WH05797>.
Let thy priests<WH03548> be clothed<WH03847><WTH8799> with righteousness<WH06664>; and let thy saints<WH02623> shout for joy<WH07442><WTH8762>.
For thy servant<WH05650> David's<WH01732> sake turn not away<WH07725><WTH8686> the face<WH06440> of thine anointed<WH04899>.<CM>

The LORD<WH03068> hath sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> <FI>in<Fi> truth<WH0571> unto David<WH01732>; he will not turn<WH07725><WTH8799> from it; Of the fruit<WH06529> of thy body<WH0990> will I set<WH07896><WTH8799> upon thy throne<WH03678>. <RF>body: Heb. belly<Rf>

If thy children<WH01121> will keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my covenant<WH01285> and my testimony<WH05713> that<WH02090><WTH8675><WH02097> I shall teach<WH03925><WTH8762> them, their children<WH01121> shall also sit<WH03427><WTH8799> upon thy throne<WH03678> for evermore<WH05703>.
For the LORD<WH03068> hath chosen<WH0977><WTH8804> Zion<WH06726>; he hath desired<WH0183><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> for his habitation<WH04186>.
This <FI>is<Fi> my rest<WH04496> for ever<WH05703>: here will I dwell<WH03427><WTH8799>; for I have desired<WH0183><WTH8765> it.
I will abundantly<WH01288><WTH8763> bless<WH01288><WTH8762> her provision<WH06718>: I will satisfy<WH07646><WTH8686> her poor<WH034> with bread<WH03899>. <RF>abundantly: or, surely<Rf>
I will also clothe<WH03847><WTH8686> her priests<WH03548> with salvation<WH03468>: and her saints<WH02623> shall shout aloud<WH07442><WTH8762> for joy<WH07444><WTH8763>.
There will I make<WH06779><WH00> the horn<WH07161> of David<WH01732> to bud<WH06779><WTH8686>: I have ordained<WH06186><WTH8804> a lamp<WH05216> for mine anointed<WH04899>. <RF>lamp: or, candle<Rf>
His enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> will I clothe<WH03847><WTH8686> with shame<WH01322>: but upon himself shall his crown<WH05145> flourish<WH06692><WTH8686>.<CM>
